segments: The tenth cycle (Yūbālā):
The Arab kings.
Shahin the Persian captured Chalcedon,
and killed all its people.
And thus the Persians seized all the territories of the Romans from the shore of the Pontus sea to the East.
After twelve years of Heraclius, Muhammad began to be known.
For indeed, the reckoning of the lunar years of the Arabs also begins from this year:
which is the year six thousand one hundred and thirty from Adam,
and the year nine hundred and thirty-three of the Greeks,
and the year six hundred and twenty-four as from our Savior.
And in that same first year of the Arabs, Shahrbaraz captured Ancyra,
and after it Rhodes.
And in the fourth year of the Arabs, Shahrbaraz and Kardigan encamped against Constantinople,
and their forces crossed into Thrace,
and they camped against the western quarter of Constantinople,
and pressed it hard.
Then suddenly there came relief for them,
because it was reported to Khosrow:
"Shahrbaraz holds you in contempt and says,
'The victory with which you boast is his (own),
and not yours.'"
Therefore he sent to Kardigan to take off the head of Shahrbaraz.
[The] messenger was seized by the Romans.
And when Heraclius learned [this],
he sent secretly and with oaths brought Shahrbaraz in to him.
And when he entered and saw the messenger and the letter, and was convinced,
he devised a scheme and altered the letter,
and added in it three hundred commanders also, that they should be killed along with Shahrbaraz.
And he took it and went out and read it before Kardigan and before the troops.
And he said to Kardigan:
"Does it please you to do this?" And the commanders were filled with rage and scoffed at Khosrow.
They made peace with Heraclius,
and they also gave him their sons as hostages for the confirmation of the treaty of peace.
